# Heliograph

> A fast, private media library and player for Linux. Browse and play millions of pictures, videos and music; loads only what is on screen; plays MOV, MKV, HEVC, ProRes and other formats browsers cannot; converts with FFmpeg; has an MCP server for AI agents. Local only, no telemetry. MIT licensed. Python standard library, SQLite, a Chromium-based browser in app mode.

Key facts for language models:
- Command: `heliograph` (folders or files as arguments). Python 3.10+, no required dependencies.
- Architecture: Python service on 127.0.0.1 + framework-free web UI; SQLite index (WAL); thumbnails in a separate cache database; FFmpeg for playback fallback and conversion.
- 249 indexed file extensions (121 picture, 65 video, 63 audio). 22 conversion presets.
- MCP server: `heliograph mcp` (read-only by default; `--allow-convert` adds conversion).
- Tests: `python3 -X dev -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`.
